changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Ensure category_item_mapping uses composite primary key (category_id, item_id) to match JPA @EmbeddedId mapping. Pre-clean duplicates and add PK safely.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='category_item_mapping' AND column_name='id' ) THEN DELETE FROM category_item_mapping t USING category_item_mapping d WHERE t.category_id = d.category_id AND t.item_id = d.item_id AND t.ctid > d.ctid; ELSE -- Even without surrogate id, use ctid to keep one DELETE FROM category_item_mapping t USING category_item_mapping d WHERE t.category_id = d.category_id AND t.item_id = d.item_id AND t.ctid > d.ctid; END IF; END; $$;
UPDATE category_item_mapping SET id = gen_random_uuid() WHERE id IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.category_item_mapping ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
